summary: Accept the metadata correction: fixed_tabu was fully unrestricted and skew fully restricted; energies remain valid. At 100,000 evaluations each, unrestricted achieved E=75 versus 79 at n=31; skew achieved 135 versus 215 at n=47 and 241 versus 457 at n=67. Freeze 65% skew allocation only as an untested proposal, retaining tabu_scale=0.11, restart_scale=1.0, perturb_bits=0 and no balance restriction.
limitation: Only three development pairs, with one seed per length; no mixture or holdout validation. Skew runs took roughly twice the elapsed time, so comparisons are evaluation-budget matched, not time matched. Defaults were used, not shown optimal. The n=18 balance claim is reported in EV012 without its underlying evidence here. No general superiority or theorem follows.
next_question: Does the frozen 65% mixture perform reliably on held-out lengths and multiple seeds under a prespecified budget, including equal-time comparisons?
